# Home Assistant Automation Ecosystem

> Advanced, distributed Home Assistant ecosystem controlling a primary residence (`local00`) and six rental apartments (`local01`–`local06`). Integrates BoneIO 230V relays & 24V PWM dimmers, ESP32 PID heating controllers with TTGO TFT displays, Shelly WiFi RGBW ambient drivers, Reolink 4K/wide surveillance cameras, Home Assistant Voice PE satellite with stateful radio streaming, TCL Google TV automation, and Pstryk dynamic Polish energy tariff optimization.

## Key Facts & System Topology

- **Primary Residence (`local00`):** 12 physical rooms and zones including Salon, Kuchnia & Jadalnia, Sypialnia, Mała Łazienka, Duża Łazienka, Pralnia, Wiatrołap, Korytarz Wejściowy, Korytarz Sypialnie, Pokój Klary, Pokój Nikoli, Gabinet, and outdoor perimeter (Taras, Ogród, Podjazd).
- **Rental Suites (`local01` through `local06`):** 6 independent apartments, each equipped with 3 climate zones (Glowny, Lazienka, Sypialnia) controlled via ESP32 dev boards, TTGO T4 color displays, and dedicated `input_select` routine schedule selectors.
- **Relay & Dimmer Boards (DIN Rail):**
  - **BoneIO 32x10 Relay Board (`boneio-32-l-07`):** 32 × 230V relays (`light.boneio_32_l_07_new_light_01` to `_20`), 32 × digital inputs (reeds, PIRs). Includes 4 protected power supply relays (`switch.zasilanie_*`) excluded from all-off scripts.
  - **BoneIO 8-Channel PWM Dimmer (`boneio-dr-8ch-03-2c7fbc`):** 8 × 24V PWM dimming channels for architectural recessed lines, mirror lights, and kitchen spots.
- **Voice Satellite & Audio Streaming:**
  - **Home Assistant Voice PE (`media_player.home_assistant_voice_0a9bfd_media_player`):** Custom wake words, Nabu Casa Cloud Polish TTS, stateful radio player (`input_select.last_radio_station`) with 8 Polish presets (Eska Rock, RMF FM, Radio ZET, Antyradio, Radio 357, TOK FM, VOX FM, Trójka), normalized alias resolution, voice station switching (*"zmień/przełącz stację"*, *"switch/change radio"*), and morning wake-up schedules.
- **Living Room Multimedia & TV Control:**
  - **Salon TCL Google TV:** Controlled via Android TV Remote (`remote.salon_2`, `media_player.salon_2`) and Google Cast (`media_player.googletv8897_2`). Launches 6 streaming apps (Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, Max, Spotify, Prime Video), streams live HLS feeds from 5 Reolink cameras, and runs automated cinema mode.
- **Access Control & Physical Security:**
  - **Front Door Strike Lock:** Wired to BoneIO relay 23, wrapped in `lock.rygiel_drzwi_wejsciowych_lock`, triggered via `input_button.btn_entrance_door` with 2-minute safety auto-off, exterior RFID tags with alarm disarm logic, and perimeter siren `siren.reolink_duo_floodlight_poe_syrena`.
- **Dynamic Electricity Pricing, Multi-Window Dispatch & Battery Storage (Pstryk, Deye 12kW, Dynamic Battery):**
  - Hourly real-time Polish market tariffs (`sensor.pstryk_price_meter_dol` & `_gora`), multi-period aggregation backend engine (`config/pstryk_engine.py` with latest, forward 48h, today, month, year datasets and 15-min cache in `/tmp`), environment-based secrets resolution from `.env` (`PSTRYK_API_KEY_DOL`, `PSTRYK_API_KEY_GORA`, Deye credentials) without exposing inline keys, dual-tier Deye 12 kW inverter communication via zero-dependency Modbus-RTU over Solarman V5 (`config/solarman_v5_client.py`) with automatic fallback to Deye Cloud OpenAPI (`config/deye_cloud_client.py`, `https://eu1-developer.deyecloud.com`), configuration templates (`.env.example`, `config/.env.example`), dynamic IP configuration (`input_text.deye_inverter_ip`, `input_number.deye_inverter_port` with numeric text input `mode: box`), and fast multi-threaded LAN auto-discovery scanner (`--scan`, `input_button.scan_deye_inverter_ip`).
  - Pre-battery / no-PV operational phase handling (`input_boolean.deye_battery_installed`, persists across restarts): Inverter is online on AC grid with CT clamps measuring live 3-phase grid import and home load (`sensor.deye_grid_power`, `sensor.deye_consumption_power`, `sensor.deye_daily_consumption`). In pre-battery mode, battery displays `"Oczekuje na montaż"`, SOC is 0%, and usable capacities report 0.0 kWh without throwing exceptions or showing phantom values. Automatically transitions to battery mode when battery voltage > 40V.
  - Strict software access control: registers 109 and 112 are never written by software, while user-confirmed safety limits (Reg 110 Min SOC & Reg 111 Shutdown SOC) are written exclusively via 2-step confirmation (`script.confirm_and_apply_deye_battery_settings`, Modbus Function 0x06 with socket retry backoff and Deye Cloud OpenAPI fallback via `paramterType: BATT_LOW` and `customControl`, immediate cache write-through, and `homeassistant.update_entity` state sync); automatic 5-minute Read-Only ingestion via `sensor.deye_inverter_status` (`solarman_v5_client.py --read-all` or `deye_cloud_client.py --read-all`). All Deye reads pass through an intelligent 30s TTL write-on-change persistent cache (`/config/.deye_inverter_cache.json`) with semantic diffing to protect flash storage and resilient offline fallback.
  - Dynamic 6-slot Time-of-Use (TOU) schedule generation (registers 248..273 or cloud `/v1.0/order/sys/tou/update`) synced once daily at `00:30` (with 15-minute retry on failure until successful recorded in `input_datetime.deye_tou_last_synced_date` with date and time `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, and automated 03:00 failure alerting via `persistent_notification`) via `deye_tou_daily_sync_with_retry` and `script.sync_deye_inverter_tou` (with cache write-through and entity update of `sensor.deye_tou_last_sync`, `sensor.deye_inverter_status`, and `sensor.pstryk_price_meter_dol`) to position single charging slot in cheapest buy window (e.g. midday 11:00/13:00 or night) with 1-hour integer steps, and 100% household peak self-consumption discharge (zero export).
  - **Engine/HA contract (current):** Reg 108 (max charge current) IS written by the engine (modulation via `set_charge_current`/`--restore-charge-current`), always based on `BATTERY_CHARGE_CURRENT_MAX_CEILING_A` (100A), never on the live register value (no ratchet); `--restore-charge-current` restores 100A. Reg 109 is never written. Reg 112 (Max SOC) is never written: `input_number.deye_battery_max_charge_soc` is the source of truth and is no longer overwritten from the inverter. Min/Shutdown SOC (Reg 110/111) are written only via the Confirm button. `input_boolean.deye_battery_installed` persists across restarts (no `initial:`); battery automations/templates run when it is `on` OR telemetry reports a battery installed; toggle is on both dashboards. `input_select.battery_discharge_target_hours` / `ev_charging_target_hours` drive the engine via `--sell-target-hours` / `--ev-target-hours` (EV `auto` = 2h weekday / 4h weekend, weekday computed in Europe/Warsaw; sell default 3h); cached payloads are reused only if target hours match. Helpers (pre-peak margin, selects, inverter IP/port) no longer reset on restart (`initial:` removed). `script.sync_deye_inverter_tou`: `mode: queued`, `max: 2`, `continue_on_error`; on success sets `input_datetime.deye_tou_last_synced_date` and refreshes `sensor.deye_tou_last_sync`, `sensor.deye_inverter_status`, `sensor.pstryk_price_meter_dol` and `_gora`; on failure the date is not touched. TOU generation is minute-based, midnight-wrap safe, always 6 strictly increasing slots (evening/night charge and morning/midday sell windows supported; night branch slot 6 = min SOC); 'today' is the Europe/Warsaw day; TOU is not written (and the payload not cached) if the day's prices are incomplete. Solarman TOU write aborts on the first failed register and then falls back to Deye Cloud (at most once); cloud slots carry the nominal voltage. Unit tests are hermetic (sockets blocked, tmp paths); Tier 2 sandbox must never contain the real `.env` or call real engine/client scripts. `config/pstryk_pricing.py` is legacy/unused; `pstryk_engine.py` is the engine.
  - TOU slots carry roles (charge/peak/reserve/other); stretch rule: charge->peak holds Max SOC, peak->charge Min SOC, peak->peak branch reserve (no wrap past 00:00). Dynamic morning/pre-peak boundaries derived purely from price spikes (`p_start // 2` and separation, zero clock heuristics); evening/late charges hold overnight until the morning boundary. Reg 108 modulation: base 100A ceiling, dynamic reduction during charging windows ($100\text{A} \times 2/T$), 100A baseline outside windows. TOU written/cached only if the Warsaw day is covered (<=1h missing, `PRICE_COVERAGE_MAX_MISSING_HOURS`). Local Modbus 25s budget (`LOCAL_TIME_BUDGET_S`) starts at the first failure; sync aborts on first failed write, then cloud (once). Read-back labels relative to min/max SOC (`TOU_LABEL_SOC_TOLERANCE`). Details: AGENTS.md / SPEC_DEYE_BATTERY_SYSTEM.md §4.
  - In Deye hybrid inverters, TOU `Power(W)` strictly controls maximum discharge power (battery to load/grid): all 6 slots stay at full base power ($P_{\text{base}} = 140\text{A} \times 51.2\text{V} \approx \mathbf{7170\text{W}}$) so household load coverage is never throttled. Charging speed during extended charging windows ($T > 2\text{h}$) is dynamically modulated via Modbus Holding Register 108 (`Max A Charge`: hard clamped to `BATTERY_CHARGE_CURRENT_MAX_CEILING_A` 100A, modulated dynamically down to $100\text{A} \times (2/T)$ inside extended charging windows, and strictly restored to baseline 100A ceiling outside all charging windows in this No-PV installation). Holding Register 109 (Max Discharge Current) is strictly read-only. Slot 6 in night charging branches (01:00–03:00) discharges to `safe_min_soc` (15%) for night standby awaiting 01:00. CLI `--print-tou` renders human-readable ASCII schedule tables for Today and Tomorrow (`--tomorrow`).
  - Mathematical dynamic battery model: strictly read-only hardware specifications via template sensors (`sensor.powerbank_total_capacity_kwh`, `sensor.powerbank_voltage_v`, `sensor.deye_inverter_max_charge_current` dynamically read from inverter Holding Registers 102, 587, 108; static hardcoding strictly prohibited by Rule 9), active editable sliders (`input_number.deye_battery_max_charge_soc`, `input_number.deye_morning_reserve_margin_pct`, `input_number.deye_pre_peak_margin_pct`, `input_number.deye_battery_min_discharge_soc`, `input_number.deye_battery_shutdown_soc`), 2-step confirmation process (`binary_sensor.deye_battery_critical_parameters_pending`, `script.confirm_and_apply_deye_battery_settings`, `script.revert_deye_battery_settings_from_inverter`), usable capacity, blackout reserve, cell buffer, transfer rates, and automated 100% BMS cell balancing calibration every 30 days.
  - Strict Single Source of Truth architecture (Rule 10) via `config/energy_defaults.py`: dynamically loads baseline templates (`.env.example`) and env overrides (`.env`), eliminating duplicate hardcoded fallback literals (`16.13`, `51.2`, `100.0`) from Python/YAML. Enforced via mandatory pre-check tool `scripts/check_duplicate_variable.py` (`--search <term>` and `--validate`) and invariant test suite `tests/invariants/test_no_duplicate_defaults.py`.
  - Multi-window auto-dispatch with UI average prices: EV window (auto 2h weekday / 4h weekend, or fixed 2/3/4/6h via `input_select.ev_charging_target_hours`), Power Bank window (weekdays strictly 2h, weekends dynamic up to 5h based on lowest spot prices with +0.05 PLN/kWh tolerance expansion over base 2h average, `allow_disjoint = False`), Peak Price window (3h–5h + 1h spike), dynamic Morning Reserve via `input_number.deye_morning_reserve_margin_pct` (default +10% SOC to cover 06:00–10:00 morning spikes), Energy Delta ($\Delta SOC$) dynamic power scaling with 10% loss buffer, pre-peak daytime autokonsumpcja (Variant B: $\min(\text{max\_soc}, \text{min\_soc} + \text{pre\_peak\_margin})$ via `input_number.deye_pre_peak_margin_pct`, default 20%), idempotent diff check (`are_tou_slots_identical()`, skipping identical writes to prevent flash wear), hourly recalculation automation (`deye_tou_hourly_recalculation`), and parameter change sync (`deye_battery_parameters_change_sync` triggering on non-critical helpers with 5s debounce, paused when critical parameters are pending confirmation), with Max SOC (50–100%) persisting across restarts via `input_number.deye_battery_max_charge_soc` while Min SOC (Batt LOW) is read directly from physical Deye inverter registers (`sensor.deye_inverter_min_discharge_soc`, default 20%), cleanly partitioned into stable **Today** and published **Tomorrow** profiles (Day-Ahead spot prices published ~12:00 Warsaw time).
  - UI modernization in `dashboard_modern_reference.yaml` & `dashboard_home_improved.yaml`: Responsive 2-column grids (zero text truncation), unified `Rekomendowane Okna Dyspozytorskie & Status` entities card, planned charge speed badge (`Planowany Prąd Ładowania: 66 A | Deye Reg 108: 66 A`) and dynamic slot charge current, streamlined Pstryk Dół/Góra 2-column tiles, responsive 4-column reporting tables in `/energia-raport` (`Okres | Dół | Góra | Razem`), and strict Lovelace schema integrity invariants (Rule 11 enforced by `tests/invariants/test_dashboard_schemas.py`).
  - Automated 22:00 daily evening notification (`daily_energy_price_notification`) pre-refreshing Pstryk metrics and sending the multi-window forecast specifically for **Tomorrow** (EV, Magazyn, Szczyt Cenowy).
- **Dynamic Solar & Astronomical Calculations:**
  - Real-time astronomical solar calculator (`config/solar_engine.py` via Astral 2.2), dynamic `input_datetime` helpers (`dynamic_dawn`, `dynamic_sunrise`, `dynamic_sunset`, `dynamic_outdoor_dusk`) with Polish UI friendly names and strictly English YAML keys, template sensors (`sensor.dynamic_solar_phase`, `sensor.dynamic_solar_elevation`, `sensor.dynamic_solar_engine_status`), binary solar flags, daily synchronization automation, and fail-safe fallback protection. All automations and scripts have migrated from static manual times to dynamic solar times.

## Core Documentation Index

- [AI_DEVELOPMENT_GUIDELINES.md](AI_DEVELOPMENT_GUIDELINES.md): Mandatory AI development rules, strict planning mode gates, documentation self-update protocols, Rule 9 zero-hardcoding invariant, Rule 10 single source of truth, Rule 11 Lovelace dashboard schema integrity, and hardware invariants.
- [SPEC_DEYE_BATTERY_SYSTEM.md](SPEC_DEYE_BATTERY_SYSTEM.md): Mandatory architecture specification for Deye hybrid inverter, battery storage, dynamic capacity register 102, write-on-change caching layer, and Rule 9 zero-hardcoding invariants.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Primary developer guidelines, operational safety rules, Docker container management, and entity mapping directory for Home Assistant agents.
- [AGENT.md](AGENT.md): Unified bridge specification between Home Assistant and the ESP32/Node.js edge firmware (`newHeatingController`, `heatingStation`, `nodeApi`).
- [PLACES_AND_BEHAVIORS.md](PLACES_AND_BEHAVIORS.md): Exhaustive room-by-room entity directory, automation behaviors, triggers, conditions, actions, voice intents, and safety constraints for every physical space in the ecosystem.
- [tests/sandbox.py](tests/sandbox.py): Hermetic Tier 2 sandbox (`create_sandbox()`: sandbox `.env` with loopback inverter and blank secrets, engine/client shell and command_line commands stubbed via `tests/test_config_overlay/test_stub_cmd.sh`, MQTT -> `ha-test-mqtt`); guarded by [tests/invariants/test_sandbox_hermetic.py](tests/invariants/test_sandbox_hermetic.py); `preconditions.stub_rc` scenario field sets stub exit code; `runner.py --auto` runs Tier 2 for every impacted area (new `deye` area with deye scenarios). Remaining side effects: InPost API poll (`rest.yaml`), copied `secrets.yaml`.
- [tests/runner.py](tests/runner.py): Autonomous 4-tier AI test harness (Tier 0 static schema check, Tier 1A hardware safety invariants, Tier 1B Python unit test suites with `--tier unit`, Tier 2 ephemeral Docker state execution, Tier 3 Lovelace UI validation).
- [tests/test_registry.yaml](tests/test_registry.yaml): Master static regression test catalog protecting verified system behaviors across rooms and subsystems.
- [CAMERA_AI_FACE_RECOGNITION_PROPOSAL.md](CAMERA_AI_FACE_RECOGNITION_PROPOSAL.md): Generic Camera AI Vision Engine (`script.camera_ai_analyze`) utilizing Google Generative AI (Gemini Vision) for biometric face recognition (door strike unlocking) and Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR/ANPR for sliding gate access and driveway illumination).
- [VOICE_AI_IMPROVEMENTS_PROPOSAL.md](VOICE_AI_IMPROVEMENTS_PROPOSAL.md): Architectural proposal for Polish Voice AI intent remediation, entity aliasing, and area classification across the ecosystem.
- [HA_IMPROVEMENTS_RESEARCH.md](HA_IMPROVEMENTS_RESEARCH.md): Research notes and audit findings on Home Assistant modern configurations and dashboard modernization.

## Lovelace Dashboards & User Interfaces

- **Dom iPad Modern (`/dashboard-home`):** Configured in [`config/dashboard_modern_reference.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/dashboard_modern_reference.yaml) and [`config/dashboard_home_improved.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/dashboard_home_improved.yaml). Features dedicated views for Dom (`/dom` with InPost Paczkomat MAR13M air quality & weather telemetry), Klimat (`/klimat`), Oświetlenie (`/oswietlenie`), Energia (`/energia`), Multimedia (`/media`), and drill-down interactive reporting subview (`/energia-raport`) with Dół vs Góra comparisons, Jinja2 hourly/daily/monthly tables, and 48h live history graphs.
- **Korytarze i Pokoje (`/dashboard-korytarze`):** Configured in [`config/dashboard_korytarze_improved.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/dashboard_korytarze_improved.yaml). Compact lighting matrix organized by physical rooms with Shelly animation controls.
- **Main & Rental Overview (`/dashboard-improved`):** Configured in [`config/dashboard_improved.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/dashboard_improved.yaml). Comprehensive multi-apartment view displaying climate setpoints, routines, and temperatures across `local00`–`local06`.

## Key Configuration Files

- [`config/configuration.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/configuration.yaml): Root HA settings, input helpers (`input_text.pending_ui_operations`, `input_text.deye_inverter_ip`), light groups (`light.taras_lampy`), Pstryk command-line sensors, and custom voice intents (`intent_script`).
- [`config/mqtt.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/mqtt.yaml): MQTT integration defining 26+ climate entities, 40+ temperature/heating state sensors, and `light.salon_mqtt`.
- [`config/automations.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/automations.yaml): 60+ automation rules governing motion lighting, door strike timeouts, RFID security, morning radio, Pstryk alerts, UI pending operations auto-clear, and rental heating schedules.
- [`config/scripts.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/scripts.yaml): Operational scripts including `play_radio`, `stop_radio`, `tv_launch_app`, `tv_show_camera`, `salon_cinema_mode`, `confirm_and_apply_deye_battery_settings`, `set_ui_operation_pending`, `clear_ui_operation_pending`, and bedroom roller shutter controls.
- [`config/customize.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/customize.yaml): Entity customization providing Polish friendly names, voice aliases, and icon assignments.
- [`config/templates.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/templates.yaml): Template sensors for Pstryk cheapest windows, UI pending operation detectors (`ui_op_pending_deye_battery_safety`), waste collection countdown, template lock, dynamic solar elevation, phase, and outdoor dusk flags.
- [`config/rest.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/rest.yaml): REST integration polling InPost Paczkomat MAR13M hyper-local weather and air quality sensors (air index level, temperature, humidity, pressure, PM1, PM2.5, PM10).
- [`config/solar_engine.py`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/solar_engine.py): Dynamic solar and astronomical calculation engine (Astral 2.2) with fail-safe fallbacks.
- [`config/energy_defaults.py`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/energy_defaults.py): Single source of truth for energy and battery fallback defaults (Rule 10), dynamically loading `.env.example` templates and `.env` overrides with zero duplicate numeric literals in Python.
- [`scripts/check_duplicate_variable.py`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/scripts/check_duplicate_variable.py): Variable pre-check and AST validator tool enforcing variable reuse and blocking hardcoded literals.
- [`config/custom_sentences/pl/dom_sentences.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/custom_sentences/pl/dom_sentences.yaml): Polish voice sentence triggers for radio, TV streaming apps, camera casting, cinema mode, blinds, and gates.
- [`config/custom_sentences/en/dom_sentences.yaml`](file:///Users/wtrzonkowski/Desktop/private/homeassistant/config/custom_sentences/en/dom_sentences.yaml): English voice sentence triggers mirroring the Polish intent set.
